title: The Study to Evaluate Toripalimab (JS001) in Patients With Advanced GC, ESCC, NPC, HNSCC
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to preliminarily evaluate anti-tumor activity of a Recombinant Humanized Anti-PD-1 Monoclonal Antibody for Infusion (JS001) in treating advanced gastric adenocarcinoma, esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, nasopharyngeal carcinoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and to determine the recommended phase II dose (RP2D)
condition: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
